verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS accounting platform with a public REST API, but nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP event callbacks. Invoice paid/viewed notifications are user-facing alerts, the MCP server's HTTPS callback is an OAuth redirect URI, and the REST SDKs and MCP CRUD tools are pull-based building blocks, so none of these qualify.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
